Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + rebook after missed sync

Hi Jordan —

Hope you’re doing well. We missed you on today’s discovery sync (totally understand — calendars get messy). Quick recap attached and a short ask to rebook: I’ve proposed three compact windows below. If you can reply with a single number (1 / 2 / 3) I’ll lock the calendar and include the right engineers. If I don’t hear back by EOD Monday I’ll release the slots.

Attachments: postcall-recap.pdf (pdf) — 1-page call notes and priorities

Proposed compact windows (all PDT):
  1) Tue Apr 20 — 09:00–09:30 (we can tighten to 09:10–09:30 if you prefer)
  2) Tue Apr 20 — 11:00–11:30 (includes solutions engineer)
  3) Wed Apr 21 — 08:30–09:00 (early slot)

Agenda (15–30m):
- 5m: priority business context / success metrics
- 10–15m: focused walkthrough on inference latency & cost controls (what matters to Starlite)
- 5–10m: next steps & mutual action plan

If none of these work, tell me a single 30-min window you have next week and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks — quick one-line reply is perfect.

—
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hey Olga —

Really sorry about today — an ops fire pulled me into back-to-back calls and I couldn’t get out in time. Appreciate the recap.

I can do option 1 but only for 20 minutes (morning is best for me). Would you be able to shift to 09:10–09:30 on Tue Apr 20 instead of the full 30m? If not, I can try to free up 11:00 but that’s unlikely.

Also — can you send a short pre-read (one pager) on how Redwood handles prefix caching + routing? That’ll help me prep.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
Starlite Analytics
jordan.lee@starliteanalytics.com | +1 (415) 999-2200

I’ve attached an updated one-page agenda and a short integration outline: integration-outline.pdf (pdf) + updated-agenda.md (md). Please do the single-line confirm ("Confirm") when you can — I’ll only finalize the calendar after that so we don’t hold the slot unnecessarily.

- We’ll focus on the three things you called out: latency SLOs, model routing, and data handling for embeddings.

- If you want a deeper ops session, we can follow up with a 45m session with engineering.

If I don’t hear "Confirm" by 5pm PDT today I’ll keep the slot tentatively held until EOD Monday and then release it.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
